Then the system disables its user accounts and open instructions are recalled

edits.new:
Then the system disables its user accounts and open instructions are recalled

  Scenario: AC3 A caller without the partner-portal right is refused before any read or write (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given a caller that does not hold the partner-portal right of the operation
    When the caller asks for a partner read
    Then the system returns 403 with MSG-P4-002 before any read or write

  Scenario: AC4 A partner account that is unknown or whose validity has passed is refused (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given a partner account that is unknown, or whose valid_to has passed
    When the caller asks for a partner read
    Then the system returns 403 with MSG-P4-002 and no firm, instruction or fee

  Scenario: AC5 An instruction of another firm is refused (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given a caller of one firm
    When the caller asks for an instruction of another firm
    Then the system returns 404 and takes the scope from the user's row

  Scenario: AC6 A stalled rwb-access read returns 503 (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given the rwb-access read does not answer inside 2 s
    When the partner read runs
    Then the caller sees 503

  Scenario: AC7 A statement outside rwb_partner is refused by the build (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given a statement reaches a v_ace_* view, a recovery_case row or another schema
    When the boundary test runs
    Then the grant refuses it and the build fails
